description: Function/action-group contracts for the TurnRiverSDR Master Agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Each entry maps to a Bedrock action group. Research/writing functions produce artifacts only; STAGING/TRIGGER functions (stage_enrollment, trigger_n8n_dry_run) cause side effects and MUST be guarded by the compliance gate + a human approval event.

functions.name: create_icp
functions.description: Create a versioned ICP (icp_versions) artifact from an approved company brief and constraints. Never invents product claims; brief/KB only.

constraints.description: Firmographics, role, pains, triggers, exclusions, scoring weights.

functions.name: search_knowledge
functions.description: Retrieve approved knowledge-base hits for the SAME workspace only. Cross-workspace retrieval denied by default.

functions.name: research_prospects
functions.description: Produce lead dossiers with citations (source URL, timestamp) and confidence labels per claim, using licensed sources only (Clay/Amplemarket/ZoomInfo). No autonomous scraping.

functions.name: score_leads
functions.description: Score contacts against an ICP version → lead_score (score, reason_codes, confidence) and lead-state transitions. Suppression always wins; never auto-stages.

functions.name: generate_sequence
functions.description: Generate editable, channel-aware sequence JSON with merge fields, evidence-grounded from research.

functions.name: preview_enrollment
functions.description: Dry-run resolution of merge fields + suppression/do-not-contact check against target contacts. Read-only; staging requires separate approval.

functions.name: request_approval
functions.description: Create an approval request (approval_status=requested) for a scoped external action. A completed approval event is required before ANY side-effect function.

scope.description: Exact scope: contacts, destination, sequence, counts.

functions.name: stage_enrollment
functions.description: MUST reject unless approval is approved, unexpired, payload scope matches the approved preview exactly, and every contact passes suppression/do-not-contact. Side-effect gateway.

functions.name: trigger_n8n_dry_run
functions.description: Invoke the n8n engine in DRY-RUN mode only. Never activates the production workflow without a specific approval event. Dry-run by default.

workflowKey.description: Approved n8n workflow key, e.g. prospect-automation-part1
